description: This file defines the class ProcessStatusWindow, which manages processes and streams, updates a UI window with process output, and executes commands related to firmware flashing or device maintenance.

classes.name: ProcessStatusWindow
classes.description: A class that manages executing system processes, streams their output into a UI window, and handles process lifecycle for firmware or hardware maintenance tasks.

methods.name: isWindows
methods.description: Checks if the operating system is Windows based on 'os.name' system property.

methods.name: startStreamThread
methods.description: Creates and starts a daemon thread to read output from a process stream and append it to the UI window and buffer.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Executes a system command in a specified working directory, streams output and error, and waits for completion.

methods.name: submitAction
methods.description: Runs a given Runnable task in a separate daemon thread.
